messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up — incoming enterprise ask from AcmeCorp: they want JS + Python SDKs, Terraform provisioning (org-level), and SCIM SSO sync. Sales wants rough prioritization and what "must-have" for an initial ship.
Aaron Lee: Add context: AcmeCorp committed to Dedicated if we support SCIM/SSO + infra-as-code. Sales said timeline ~Q3.
Jess Cole: Quick triage — is this a single customer-specific scope or platform-level feature request?
Priya Nair: Platform-level. They want marketplace listing too (visibility). So not a one-off.
Olivia Chen: From eng perspective: SDKs are straightforward (wrappers + tests). Terraform provider + SCIM require deeper infra + security review. SCIM needs audit log hooks and RBAC mapping.
Samir Patel: Can we propose a phased rollout? Phase 1: Python/JS SDKs + marketplace listing + docs. Phase 2: Terraform provider (GA) + example infra. Phase 3: SSO/SCIM + compliance checklist.
Matt Gomez: Agree. Suggest prioritization rubric: impact x effort. This customer = high impact (enterprise + revenue). Effort: SCIM high, Terraform medium, SDK low.
Priya Nair: I sketched acceptance criteria for Phase 1 — please check: 
```
Phase 1 acceptance:\n- SDKs (py/js) published to package registries (pip/npm)\n- End-to-end example app using hosted + dedicated configs\n- API stable surface for 1.0 (no breaking changes in 6 weeks)\n- Docs + quickstart + changelog entries\n- Security sign-off on credentials handling\n```
Aaron Lee: Add automated tests for auth flows and CI publish. Also require token-scoped usage examples.
Jess Cole: For backlog tagging, let's use: `integration/sdk`, `integration/terraform`, `integration/sso-scim`, and `priority:enterprise`. Proposed labels snippet: 
```
labels: ["integration/sdk", "integration/terraform", "integration/sso-scim", "priority:enterprise", "owner:platform"]
```
Olivia Chen: Owner suggestion: Platform SDK team for Phase 1, Infra team for Terraform + SCIM. Need 2-week spike for Terraform provider API surface.
DevRel Bot: Reminder: create intake form entry and assign to triage board -> /intake create 1849123456 AcmeCorp-integration.
Samir Patel: Can someone confirm legal/compliance gating for SCIM? I think we need DPA + SCIM SSO design review.
Priya Nair: I'll loop in Legal/Trust. Next steps: 1) Priya to add to intake and assign owners. 2) Olivia + Matt to estimate effort (due EOD Fri). 3) DevRel to draft customer-facing timeline. 4) Jess to add labels & changelog template.
Aaron Lee: +1. If estimates show Terraform/SCIM > 6w, propose a canary plan: provide SDKs + docs while building infra, with explicit GA promises.
Jess Cole: I'll create ticket skeletons with the labels and the acceptance criteria above.
Priya Nair: Thanks — capture decisions in the intake ticket. We'll revisit prioritization at roadmap sync next Tue. :spiral_calendar_pad:
